faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Director, DIA-CoE recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi for selecting a qualified professional for the Director, DIA-CoE position on a contract basis in Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT (BHU) Director, DIA-CoE Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Director, DIA-CoE post. Candidates fulfilling the required educational qualifications and experience criteria are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 30-10-2026. Interested candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Director, DIA-CoE post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctoral or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University or equivalent along with 25 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 62 years. Candidates should verify their age according to the official notification guidelines before submitting their applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their detailed CV, statement of suitability, and supporting documents in a single PDF to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for non-government employees?
faq.answer: For non-government employees, the offered salary ranges between Rs. 1,75,000 and Rs. 2,00,000 per month depending on the candidate's professional experience.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the Director, DIA-CoE post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a careful review of their professional references.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Director, DIA-CoE position at IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official IIT (BHU) positions website at https://iitbhu.ac.in/positions to read the full notification and obtain further updates regarding the recruitment drive.
